title: Your Journey With SLEDMC
description: From initial registration to European integration, our 11-step framework ensures transparent support at every milestone.

steps.title: Register
steps.desc: Candidate registration and initial background submission.

steps.title: Candidate Assessment
steps.desc: Review experience, qualifications, language level & document status.

steps.title: Choose Career Path
steps.desc: Identify the most suitable sector and European programme.

steps.title: Language Preparation
steps.desc: Develop workplace language fluency and cultural orientation.

steps.title: Documentation & Qualifications
steps.desc: Complete legal document verification & external certifications.

steps.title: Employer Matching
steps.desc: Match verified profiles with relevant European employer vacancies.

steps.title: Employer Interview
steps.desc: Coordinate video or direct practical selection interviews.

steps.title: Employment & Mobility
steps.desc: Support visa processing with official legal and mobility partners.

steps.title: Pre-Departure
steps.desc: Final travel booking, flight checklist, and destination orientation.

steps.title: Arrival & Integration
steps.desc: On-arrival support, accommodation onboarding, and workplace integration.
